006package dev.metaschema.core.util;
007
008import java.util.ArrayList;
009import java.util.Collections;
010import java.util.HashMap;
011import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.Objects;
015import java.util.Set;
016import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
017import java.util.function.BinaryOperator;
018import java.util.function.Function;
019import java.util.function.Supplier;
020import java.util.stream.Collector;
021import java.util.stream.Collectors;
022import java.util.stream.Stream;

024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;

028/**
029 * Provides a variety of collector and other stream utilities.
030 * <p>
031 * This class provides thread-safe collectors and utilities for stream
032 * operations. Common usage patterns include:
033 *
034 * <pre>
035 * // Example 1: Using distinctByKey
036 * {@code
037 * Stream<Item> uniqueItems = items.stream()
038 *     .collect(CustomCollectors.distinctByKey(Item::getId));
039 * }
040 *
041 * // Example 2: Using toSequence
042 * {@code
043 * ISequence<IItem> sequence = items.stream()
044 *     .collect(CustomCollectors.toSequence());
045 * }
046 * </pre>
047 *
048 * @since 1.0.0
049 */
050@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
051public final class CustomCollectors {
052  /**
053   * An implementation of {@link Function#identity()} that respects non-nullness.
054   *
055   * @param <T>
056   *          the Java type of the identity object
057   * @return the identity function
058   */
059  @SuppressWarnings("null")
060  @NonNull
061  public static <T> Function<T, T> identity() {
062    return Function.identity();
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Joins a sequence of string values using oxford-style serial commas.
067   *
068   * @param conjunction
069   *          the conjunction to use after the penultimate comma (e.g., and, or)
070   * @return a collector that will perform the joining
071   */
072  public static Collector<CharSequence, ?, String> joiningWithOxfordComma(@NonNull String conjunction) {
073    return Collectors.collectingAndThen(Collectors.toList(), withOxfordComma(conjunction));
074  }
075
076  private static Function<List<CharSequence>, String> withOxfordComma(@NonNull String conjunction) {
077    return list -> {
078      int size = list.size();
079      if (size < 2) {
080        return String.join("", list);
081      }
082      if (size == 2) {
083        return String.join(" " + conjunction + " ", list);
084      }
085      // else there are 3 or more
086      int last = size - 1;
087      return String.join(", " + conjunction + " ",
088          String.join(", ", list.subList(0, last)),
089          list.get(last));
090    };
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Produce a new stream with duplicates removed based on the provided
095   * {@code keyMapper}. When a duplicate key is encountered, the second item is
096   * used. The original sequencing is preserved if the input stream is sequential.
097   * <p>
098   * Note: This method uses an underlying map that is not thread safe to maintain
099   * insertion order.
100   *
101   * @param <V>
102   *          the item value for the streams
103   * @param <K>
104   *          the key type
105   * @param stream
106   *          the stream to reduce
107   * @param keyMapper
108   *          the key function to use to find unique items
109   * @return a new stream
110   */
111  public static <V, K> Stream<V> distinctByKey(
112      @NonNull Stream<V> stream,
113      @NonNull Function<? super V, ? extends K> keyMapper) {
114    return distinctByKey(stream, keyMapper, (key, value1, value2) -> value2);
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Produce a new stream with duplicates removed based on the provided
119   * {@code keyMapper}. When a duplicate key is encountered, the provided
120   * {@code duplicateHandler} is used to determine which item to keep. The
121   * original sequencing is preserved if the input stream is sequential.
122   * <p>
123   * Note: This method uses an underlying map that is not thread safe to maintain
124   * insertion order.
125   *
126   * @param <V>
127   *          the item value for the streams
128   * @param <K>
129   *          the key type
130   * @param stream
131   *          the stream to reduce
132   * @param keyMapper
133   *          the key function to use to find unique items
134   * @param duplicateHander
135   *          used to determine which of two duplicates to keep
136   * @return a new stream
137   */
138  public static <V, K> Stream<V> distinctByKey(
139      @NonNull Stream<V> stream,
140      @NonNull Function<? super V, ? extends K> keyMapper,
141      @NonNull DuplicateHandler<K, V> duplicateHander) {
142    Map<K, V> uniqueRoles = stream
143        .collect(toMap(
144            keyMapper,
145            identity(),
146            duplicateHander,
147            LinkedHashMap::new));
148    return uniqueRoles.values().stream();
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * Produces a map collector that uses the provided key and value mappers, and a
153   * duplicate hander to manage duplicate key insertion.
154   *
155   * @param <T>
156   *          the item Java type
157   * @param <K>
158   *          the map key Java type
159   * @param <V>
160   *          the map value Java type
161   * @param keyMapper
162   *          the function used to produce the map's key based on the provided
163   *          item
164   * @param valueMapper
165   *          the function used to produce the map's value based on the provided
166   *          item
167   * @param duplicateHander
168   *          the handler used to manage duplicate key insertion
169   * @return the collector
170   */
171  @NonNull
172  public static <T, K, V> Collector<T, ?, Map<K, V>> toMap(
173      @NonNull Function<? super T, ? extends K> keyMapper,
174      @NonNull Function<? super T, ? extends V> valueMapper,
175      @NonNull DuplicateHandler<K, V> duplicateHander) {
176    return toMap(keyMapper, valueMapper, duplicateHander, HashMap::new);
177  }
178
179  /**
180   * Produces a map collector that uses the provided key and value mappers, and a
181   * duplicate hander to manage duplicate key insertion.
182   *
183   * @param <T>
184   *          the item Java type
185   * @param <K>
186   *          the map key Java type
187   * @param <V>
188   *          the map value Java type
189   * @param <M>
190   *          the Java type of the resulting map
191   * @param keyMapper
192   *          the function used to produce the map's key based on the provided
193   *          item
194   * @param valueMapper
195   *          the function used to produce the map's value based on the provided
196   *          item
197   * @param duplicateHander
198   *          the handler used to manage duplicate key insertion
199   * @param supplier
200   *          the supplier used to create the resulting map
201   * @return the collector
202   */
203  @NonNull
204  public static <T, K, V, M extends Map<K, V>> Collector<T, ?, M> toMap(
205      @NonNull Function<? super T, ? extends K> keyMapper,
206      @NonNull Function<? super T, ? extends V> valueMapper,
207      @NonNull DuplicateHandler<K, V> duplicateHander,
208      Supplier<M> supplier) {
209    return ObjectUtils.notNull(
210        Collector.of(
211            supplier,
212            (map, item) -> {
213              K key = keyMapper.apply(item);
214              V value = Objects.requireNonNull(valueMapper.apply(item));
215              V oldValue = map.get(key);
216              if (oldValue != null) {
217                value = duplicateHander.handle(key, oldValue, value);
218              }
219              map.put(key, value);
220            },
221            (map1, map2) -> {
222              map2.forEach((key, value) -> {
223                V oldValue = map1.get(key);
224                V newValue = value;
225                if (oldValue != null) {
226                  newValue = duplicateHander.handle(key, oldValue, value);
227                }
228                map1.put(key, newValue);
229              });
230              return map1;
231            }));
232  }
233
234  /**
235   * A handler that supports resolving duplicate keys while inserting values into
236   * a map.
237   *
238   * @param <K>
239   *          the Java type of the map's keys
240   * @param <V>
241   *          the Java type of the map's values
242   */
243  @FunctionalInterface
244  public interface DuplicateHandler<K, V> {
245    /**
246     * The handler callback.
247     *
248     * @param key
249     *          the duplicate key
250     * @param value1
251     *          the first value associated with the key
252     * @param value2
253     *          the second value associated with the key
254     * @return the value to insert into the map
255     */
256    @NonNull
257    V handle(K key, @NonNull V value1, V value2);
258  }
259
260  /**
261   * A binary operator that will always use the first of two values.
262   *
263   * @param <T>
264   *          the item type
265   * @return the operator
266   */
267  @NonNull
268  public static <T> BinaryOperator<T> useFirstMapper() {
269    return (value1, value2) -> value1;
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * A binary operator that will always use the second of two values.
274   *
275   * @param <T>
276   *          the item type
277   * @return the operator
278   */
279  @NonNull
280  public static <T> BinaryOperator<T> useLastMapper() {
281    return (value1, value2) -> value2;
282  }
283
284  /**
285   * A {@link Collector} implementation to generates a sequence from a stream of
286   * Metapath items.
287   *
288   * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
289   *          the Java type of the items
290   * @return a collector that will generate a sequence
291   */
292  @NonNull
293  public static <ITEM_TYPE extends IItem> Collector<ITEM_TYPE, ?, ISequence<ITEM_TYPE>> toSequence() {
294    return new Collector<ITEM_TYPE, List<ITEM_TYPE>, ISequence<ITEM_TYPE>>() {
295      @SuppressWarnings("null")
296      @Override
297      public Supplier<List<ITEM_TYPE>> supplier() {
298        return ArrayList::new;
299      }
300
301      @Override
302      public BiConsumer<List<ITEM_TYPE>, ITEM_TYPE> accumulator() {
303        return List::add;
304      }
305
306      @Override
307      public BinaryOperator<List<ITEM_TYPE>> combiner() {
308        return (list1, list2) -> {
309          list1.addAll(list2);
310          return list1;
311        };
312      }
313
314      @Override
315      public Function<List<ITEM_TYPE>, ISequence<ITEM_TYPE>> finisher() {
316        return list -> ISequence.ofCollection(ObjectUtils.notNull(list));
317      }
318
319      @Override
320      public Set<Characteristics> characteristics() {
321        return Collections.emptySet();
322      }
323    };
324  }
325
326  private CustomCollectors() {
327    // disable construction
328  }
329}
